results.name: Cold pre-TT133 notes really lack revision; owned original rows and unrelated canaries exist
Genuine SHARE lock makes the shipped ALTER fail near its four-second lock timeout, with no partial schema or user-data mutation
Unblocked shipped migration initializes every legacy revision to one while preserving all IDs, Unicode, CRLF, tags, pins, timestamps and unrelated data
Migrated SQL CAS advances only its matching original row; a stale precondition changes nothing
Reapplying the same SQL does not reset advanced revisions, and a genuinely new row gets default revision one
Boundary witness, NOT acceptance: external delete/recreate of the same row ID resets revision and defeats a stale revision-one precondition
No background driver errors, and owned connections drain before non-forced cleanup
